name: APPEAL_GRV_MAX_EXTENSION
description: This table contains information about the maximum extensions that can be taken for an appeal or grievance.

columns.name: APPEAL_GRV_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier (.1 item) for the appeal/grievance record.

columns.name: LINE
columns.description: The line number for the information associated with this record. Multiple pieces of information can be associated with this record.

columns.name: EXTENSION_TAT_TIME_STANDARD_C_NAME
columns.description: Which timeliness standard this line in the related group corresponds to.

columns.name: MAX_EXTENSION_DAYS
columns.description: The maximum number of days the timeframe can be extended.
